intro: Lithuanian culture is known for ancient songs, amber, and some very pink soup.

chapters.title: Food
text: Cepelinai, large potato dumplings named after zeppelin airships, are the national dish. Šaltibarščiai, a cold beetroot soup, is bright pink.

chapters.title: Traditions
text: Amber jewellery is a Baltic speciality. In Vilnius, the artists' district of Užupis declared itself a 'republic' in 1997, with its own humorous constitution.

keyTerms.meaning: Fossilised tree resin, often golden and used in jewellery.
